reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper, which already implements missing/number/worst-case-range resolution.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the amount rule stays in its single shared definition.

placement.why: The new field is computed in scheduleModel.toExternal, the API model layer that maps internal schedules to external shape.

scope.why: Only the model, handler type, a focused test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Small, typed, tested addition that delegates to the canonical helper.
